name: Meiwa Corporation
summary: Meiwa Corporation engages in the chemicals, lubricants, battery materials, automotive and mineral resources, and environmental businesses in Japan, China, and internationally. The company offers mineral resources comprising rare earth elements, rare metals, environmental products, metal products, activated carbon, quartz, inorganic raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, and others; and antinomy trioxide plus brominated and phosphorus flame retardants.
